==Overview==
The '''AfreecaTV Starleague Season 6''' (아프리카TV 스타리그 시즌6) or '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 6''', was an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on [[AfreecaTV]].

The Starleague featured 3 qualifiers held in Seoul, Gwangju and Busan on August 18, 19 and 20, 2018, respectively. Wildcard qualifiers were held on August 14, 2018 to determine fourth seed from the [[Asl5|ASL5]].<ref>[https://tl.net/forum/brood-war/536324-asl-season-6-announced-starts-september-2nd ASL Season 6 Announced (Starts September 2nd)]</ref>.

Round of 24 play began on Sunday September 2nd, 2018. Matches were broadcast every week on Sunday and Tuesday.<ref>[https://starleague.kr/ ASL6 Official Website]</ref><br>

<embedvideo service="youtube">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LcUE6eRTGjI</embedvideo>

===Format===
* '''Round of 24 group stage'''
** [[Dual tournament]] format: best-of-one
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Round of 16 group stage'''
** 12 players from the Round of 24 join the four seeds from [[AfreecaTV Starleague Season 5]]
** [[Dual tournament]] format: best-of-one
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Elimination Stage'''
** Eight player single-elimination bracket
** Quarterfinals through finals: best-of-five
